How to sow tomatoes on a small balcony

Start the seeds indoors six weeks before the last frost and keep the tray near a bright window.

Move each seedling into a deeper pot once the second pair of true leaves has opened fully.

Water in the morning so the leaves dry before the evening and the fungus has no chance to spread.

Published by the Harbour Gardening editorial desk.
